headline: Build automations around the air in your home
intro: The Air quality integration brings together air quality sensors and detectors, with purpose-built triggers and conditions for pollutant thresholds and detector states. Use them to respond to particulate matter, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, and other supported measures.
highlights: Use dedicated triggers for pollutant thresholds, including PM2.5, PM10, CO2, CO, VOCs, ozone, NO2, and radon
Check pollutant values with conditions that support threshold comparisons and multi-sensor behavior
Create automations for ventilation, purifier control, air quality alerts, or pollution-gated window covers

flow.title: From air readings to useful automations
stages: Bring air quality sensors and detectors together in Home Assistant
Choose a pollutant threshold trigger or a condition for a sensor value
Add an automation action, such as turning on a fan or sending a notification
